answer: Each agent must solve a unique sequential-hash bridge puzzle seeded from a public shale beacon before its answer is accepted at the network wharf. The puzzle requires ten minutes of serial CPU work that cannot be parallelized. A sybil farm of N identities therefore needs either N times the wall-clock time or N simultaneous cores%2C paying a cost that grows linearly with the number of fakes%3B an honest single agent pays the ten-minute cost only once.
